title: Finite bit construction: R439 frame 267 reaches a 12-ADD positive-transfer minimum (no new kappa)
body:
**Finite bit-supplier construction and restricted-class minimum; no new kappa.** PR589's six-register phase-A frame-267 circuit uses 21 ADDs. This complete-frame replacement uses **12**, and its required literal reverse cleanup gives **24,305 → 24,287 ADDs** in the local word.

The full positive integer transfer is identical. The reverse positive matrix is entrywise no larger; forward bound stays 49,347 and reverse falls 1,113,070 → 1,107,434. All 661 frame paths, 439 dirty helpers, nine COPY/ERASE pairs, original H1–H5, paid profile and rank mass 5,129 are preserved. Payload remains 93 bits below the 104-bit cap. All remaining source reads, moves and restoration operations are explicitly priced; no helper or recursive child is added.

The exact minimum is **12 for this fixed positive integer transfer on six ordered wires**, allowing repeated reads and writes. One implementation exhausts the nonnegative predecessor DAG (416,508 states / 2,366,680 edges). A separately written flat-matrix breadth-first checker fully expands depths 0–11 (2,271,945 transitions) and first reaches identity at depth 12. This is not unrestricted XOR optimality or a formal proof of the multiplication theorem.

Reproduce with standard-library Python 3.11+:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/r439-frame267-seed01/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_R439_FRAME267 gates=21->12 native_adds=24305->24287 columns=661 rank_mass=5129 controls=8`.

Completed verification includes exact integer matrices, all 64 local inputs, all 661 symbolic dirty-input columns, unchanged geometry/interface checks, a separate record interpreter, eight mathematical controls, and seven package tests including optimized minimal offline relocation and corruption rejection. Fresh unchanged C++17/Boost legality and 5/9/11-stage checks pass on both words: **883 / 1,327 / 1,549 formal columns**, all **96 bridge-omission controls** rejected. Full proof-relevant native receipts are retained. `make selected-record-check`, exact source-object checks and whitespace checks pass.

**Repository-wide coverage is incomplete:** one isolated `make verify` invocation reached its predeclared 240-second budget in inherited `endpoint-gauge-producer` (h=40). No full-suite pass is claimed. No selected complex cold replay, full changed hosted-parent invoice, outer assembly or hosted CI pass is claimed. Integration still requires supplier binding and inherited all-size/compiler, common-label/mutable-source, whole-call hosting, precision/tape and analytic obligations.

Overlap was refreshed through #924 across 714 open PRs immediately before publication. **Gareth Davidson's #904** already supplies two small-window substitutions in this frame, reaching 19 ADDs. This complete six-wire witness reaches 12, adding **14 further complete ADD savings on this frame** and a restricted-class minimum. The comparison is pinned and replayed; savings are not combined across packages. **mtpsl #691** is credited for the positive-transfer/reverse-domination approach and adapted verifier; **Hao Yan #823** treats a different historical R480 matrix. #728/#792 concern separate mini-nodes. The native wrapper adapts **Ali Romman's #688** work.

Exact base: **`91a2094f2e022930069e8cfdc810a3ea1b81cd09`**. Selected PR799 conditional κ remains **0.001661634653669567** with PR589 supplier head **`a5afc8c6169ea61ba7c51dfd3cade02cc7b13b46`**. All three execution inputs match the selected source inventory; 20 source/context pins match base Git objects. Only `research/r439-frame267-seed01/` is added. OS assignment seed **01**, bit track; no pinned coordination issue existed, so the claim is local. No merge or selected-frontier change is requested.
